row.evidence: Zenefits is now TriNet's HR Platform (zenefits.com/pricing redirects to TriNet HR Plus, priced per employee per month on quote); Okta lists it for SAML/SWA sign-in and as an HR source of truth, and no SCIM endpoint into the platform is documented.
row.notes: New row. Zenefits was rebranded as the TriNet HR Platform inside TriNet HR Plus (ASO); zenefits.com/pricing redirects to trinet.com/hr-plus/hr-platform, and HR Plus pricing is a quoted PEPM fee. Scored as a provisioning target (rule 3b): employees enter through HR hiring flows, and the platform is an HR source for other apps (Okta profile sourcing; developer webhooks on hire). No SCIM into the platform found in the developer docs or the Okta/Entra catalogues. The help centre (help.zenefits.com) requires a TriNet login to search or view articles, so confidence is low. The developer Core API is read-only and for registered partner apps. Consistent with the separate trinet row (TriNet PEO, status none).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint into the TriNet HR Platform (formerly Zenefits) is documented. Zenefits acts as an HR source of truth for other apps (Okta profile sourcing, developer platform events).

capabilities.notes: Core API is read-only (GET on all URLs); writes are not documented.

endpoints.purpose: List people for the company the token applies to

user_api.notes: Developer platform for registered partner apps (OAuth2, admin-authorised, scopes reviewed before go-live); it feeds HR data to other services rather than managing who can sign in to TriNet.

okta.notes: OIN capabilities read from page markup: SAML and SWA (last updated Mar. 2 2022). The app also uses Zenefits as an HR source of truth for Okta (inbound to Okta), not provisioning into Zenefits.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound only: HR source of truth for Okta and partner apps (developer platform webhooks on hiring flows)
fallbacks.notes: Developer docs are public; the help centre requires a TriNet login.
